detail.longDescription: General callout to ask about the state of the standard (if there is even such a thing) of SWE technical interview. Also rough headcount to provide context if able :) We may be past the point of leetcode challenges, but now different companies have different levels of acceptance for AI assistance. One data point talked about technical interviews where a candidate was interrupted and asked to lean on the LLM more. Some companies have shied away from AI and any indication or disclosure of AI assistance is a red flag. Other companies continue to test coding abiltiy as a baseline expectation and do allow LLMs purely for boilerplate or autocomplete. Follow up: does your company's AI guidelines for interview candidates align with the guidelines for employees?
